risks.risk: Freezer may not be in working condition or may have cooling issues.

risks.risk: Interior frost and moisture may indicate defrosting problems or poor insulation.
risks.proof: A close-up of the interior walls and back panel to check for excessive ice buildup or damage, and a photo of the condenser coils if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential cooling inefficiency

Close-up of the control panel or thermostat, if any.
